config.calendar: common total horizon; no-pilot starts immediately, pilot main starts after pilot and gap
config.capacity_scope: instrument_budget caps formal IV count; broad pilot temporarily observes all d
config.cost_unit: one IV variable at one time, including required history
config.randomization: shared Random schedule drawn independently before observing data
config.scenario_strength: first-stage Frobenius norm fixed across scenarios for each DGP seed
config.selection_score: pilot joint-HAC regularized logdet increment per cost; ridge=1e-6
config.standardization: pilot arms use pilot X; no-pilot arms use their own main X
config.uncertainty: conditional Monte Carlo errors within fixed DGP; no post-selection confidence intervals
config.xy_assumption: full-horizon X/Y are existing records available to all arms; zero incremental X/Y cost
